title: Samsung expects capex to rise ~60% to ~$63B this year, with HBM capacity sold out through 2027 and 10 long-term supply deals secured with key customers (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Samsung expects capex to rise ~60% to ~$63B this year, with HBM capacity sold out through 2027 and 10 long-term supply deals secured with key customers — Samsung Electronics Co. plans to hike spending more than 60% this year after selling out of high-end chips for 2027 …
